$comment: Vommet's "What's new" list, shown after an update (every entry newer than the build the user last opened) and under Settings › About › What's New. The sync session adds ONE entry at the TOP when it cuts a testing build: "date" = the cut time in UTC (ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-10-07T21:40:00Z), "changes" = one short sentence per change testers can notice, in plain language (what changed for them, not how). Leave out internal-only changes (CI, refactors, tests). Newest entry first.

changes: You can crop or rotate a picture before sending it: tap the crop button on the attached picture, and the X next to it removes the attachment.
Appearance has a new Theme mode setting: choose one theme, or follow the system and pick any theme, including gradients and your own, for light and for dark.
Calls left behind by a closed app are cleared when Vommet starts, homeservers without call support now say so, and the message menu no longer loses the react option if an emoji pack fails to load.
Linux notifications no longer turn tags or links in a message or name into formatting; they show them as text.
Pick your own app font in Settings › Appearance: Atkinson Hyperlegible, Lexend, OpenDyslexic, Inter, your device's font, or a font file.

Voice messages can be turned into text on your computer (Linux and Windows): tap the →A button on a voice message; the audio never leaves your device, and the speech model is downloaded once, after asking.
If UnifiedPush is on and several distributor apps are installed but none is chosen, Vommet now asks you to pick one so notifications don't silently stop.
If a contact whose identity Vommet remembered suddenly has no identity at all, you now get the red "identity changed" warning instead of the quiet "can't confirm" note.
Windows notifications now show up for messages containing & or <, and message text can no longer add its own buttons to them.
A recovery key you copied for your password manager is now taken off the clipboard however you leave setup, not only after the check step.
New sticker packs only go into sticker rooms you created yourself; sticker rooms others share with you are never the default place for imports.
Your space nickname is never written into a direct message, even if the space lists that DM.
Automatic media download now also holds back pictures and videos sent in unusual message types.
A sticker that decrypts while the room is open no longer keeps "Failed to decrypt" above it until you reopen the room.
A message with an out-of-range timestamp now shows as written instead of failing to display.
Installing a theme from a .zip can no longer write files outside the theme's folder.
You can now mark pictures and videos as spoilers when sending them, and spoilers from other apps arrive blurred until you tap them.
Addresses like example.com in messages now turn into links, like on Telegram (Settings › General › "Link bare web addresses" turns it off).
Phones keep the normal phone layout when turned sideways, instead of switching to a cramped desktop layout; tablets still get the desktop layout.
On a device that isn't confirmed yet, Settings › Security now starts with "Confirm this device": enter your recovery key or approve from another device in one tap.
Settings and menus now use consistent capitalization and punctuation (sentence case, periods at the end of descriptions, and the Oxford comma).

New Nordic and Nordic Polar themes, the theme list now shows a little picture of each theme, and Follow System Brightness / Colors grey out for gradient and imported themes (they never applied there).
Make your own theme: Settings › Appearance › Theme › Create theme (or Edit current) lets you change every color with a live preview, then save it or share it as a file.
The theme editor can also set a gradient or picture background, see-through panels, rounder corners and spacing, and gradient themes can now be edited.

When a recovery key doesn't work, the sign-in setup now says why (a typo in the key, or nothing stored for it to unlock) and tries every stored key; verifying this device from Element now finishes the setup instead of still asking for the key.

Messages from before you joined an encrypted room that the person who invited you couldn't share now say so ("The sender didn't share this message with people who joined later") instead of "Failed to decrypt event", and the "shared by" note mentions when some earlier messages weren't shared.
Opening a widget while another one is running works again.
Settings › Advanced has a new Clear cache button: if rooms, threads or messages look wrong, Vommet downloads them again. You stay logged in and keep your keys.
Changing the app language now takes effect right away, no restart needed.

A new setting, Settings › Appearance › Message actions on hover, makes the bar over a message compact (the new default, tucked into the message's corner so it no longer covers the message above), full, or off.
Pin a message just for yourself: "Pin for me" in a message's menu works in any room, your pins show at the top of Pinned Messages, and a small outline pin marks them in the chat. Only you see them.
Hovering the close button on the "A new version is out" bar no longer turns the whole app white.
On Android, the back button closes Vommet again from the room list (it did nothing there after going back from a chat).
Automatic media download settings now also hold back pictures and videos that were sent as files.
On Linux, widgets also open when Chromium is installed as chromium-browser (Fedora), or with Chrome, Brave, Edge or Vivaldi.
A widget added from a pasted link now gets its own name and icon from its page instead of showing its web address.
Thread cards now show the reply count and latest reply your server has now, so a deleted reply no longer lingers on the card.
On Linux, opening a widget right after another one no longer shows "localhost refused to connect".
"Open on another device" links for widgets now work on computers that also have an IPv6 address.
On Windows, widgets no longer open as a frozen white window.
Sliding sync is now on by default for faster syncing (it falls back to regular sync on servers without it; if you turned it off, it stays off).
Android: Settings › Advanced › Renderer lets you switch how Vommet draws (Default, OpenGL or Compatibility), for phones where letters go missing from text.
On Linux (Flatpak), widgets open again on desktops whose display isn't the default one (for example wayland-1).
A closed sidebar folder now really shows the unread mark when something inside it is unread (it was drawn just off the edge of the sidebar).
Try Drawpile from the widget picker: paint together on one shared canvas (an experiment, on drawpile.net's public server).
The first-run diagnostics question now has a box for your name tag and a note that saying yes really helps during early testing; Settings › Privacy shows the same note next to the tag.
An open thread no longer shows messages twice or replies above the first message.

Calls with Element Call users work again: their audio gets a tile instead of an empty grey box, and in a call hosted on another homeserver's call server you can now unmute and be heard (Vommet speaks from your own homeserver's call server when the call's only lets you listen).
The voice room list no longer shows a grey box when someone joins the call from Element Call.
Tap an invitation to see the room and who invited you before accepting, decline and block the person or their whole server, and manage it all in the new Settings › Invitations.
GIFs from Telegram, WhatsApp and Discord bridges now play by themselves on a loop like GIFs, and a new "Autoplay GIFs" setting lets you keep all GIFs still until you tap them.
Pictures sent as a file (for example from another app's "attach file" button) now show as pictures instead of a download chip.
The sign-in screen shows one way in at a time: "Continue" for browser sign-in, or "Login" once you open the password form.
Spaces' colours are worked out in the background, so the app no longer stutters for a moment a few seconds after it opens.
Most of Vommet's own text can now be translated (a volunteer is working on Spanish, Portuguese, Chinese and Esperanto).
Settings › Appearance › Theme now shows the name of the theme you're using, gradients included.
On phones, a space without a banner now shows its name at full width instead of splitting long words.
Vommet starts faster and keeps up better with many rooms: updates go straight to the room they belong to instead of every room checking each one.

Settings › General has a Language setting: pick any language Vommet ships (shown in its own name, with how much is translated) instead of always following your system; Traditional Chinese, Brazilian Portuguese and Esperanto now work.
Messages you can read because the person who invited you shared the room's history now say who shared them.
On phones the "+" (new room) button at the end of the Home room list is no longer hidden behind the navigation bar.
Leaving a space now also lists rooms nested more than eight subspaces deep.
On Wayland, Share screen now lets you pick a single app window in the system dialog, not just a whole screen; cancelling it keeps a share that was already running.
With "Watch streams like Discord" on, your own screen share gets its own tile next to yours (dimmed, with Stop streaming), and your tile shows LIVE.
Opening a thread now shows every reply with the first message on top, and deleted threads no longer linger in the Threads list.
Vommet starts faster and handles room updates faster: it no longer rebuilds your list of direct messages every time it checks whether a room is one.
Vommet starts faster: the sidebar's unread badges are counted once per burst of updates instead of once for every room update.
Vommet starts faster: each space's colours are worked out from its avatar once, after startup, instead of on every update.
Inviting someone to a space now lets you pick its rooms too, and shows which rooms will share their earlier messages.
With the Discord-style layout, room widgets now have their own Widgets tab in the member panel instead of an entry in the room menu.
Widgets you can watch but not use show a View only badge, and a greyed Add widget tile says which role can add widgets.
New Settings › Appearance › Member list option: show a member's homeserver, their status, or both on one line; statuses saved on a profile now show in the member list too.
In Explore rooms, voice rooms without a picture show headphones instead of a letter, and voice rooms with a picture get a headphones mark beside their name.
Closing a thread with the Discord-style layout on no longer turns the window grey.
"Load older messages" now keeps loading until the screen fills or the room's beginning, instead of stopping again after a few more pages.
You can now remove a room's or space's icon: tap it in Appearance settings and choose Remove Image; icons removed or changed from another app now update without a restart.

Room admins can replace a room (upgrade it to a new room version or point it to another room) from Room settings → Advanced; a replaced room shows "Go to the new room" instead of the message box, the new room links back to the old messages, and the old room leaves the sidebar once you've joined its replacement.
Hanging up a call no longer hangs for a minute when the server is slow: the call ends within 3 seconds and leaving finishes in the background.
Push to talk: pick it in Voice settings, then hold your key or the "Hold to talk" button in a call to talk.
Leave Space now opens on the list of rooms and subspaces you're in there, all ticked except ones you're also in through another space; a half-ticked subspace stays joined.

Rooms whose older history is only membership and profile changes no longer page back forever with a spinner; loading pauses after a few empty pages and offers a "Load older messages" button. The member list now fills in members and roles that arrive after it opens.
Calendar rooms keep syncing their external calendars instead of stopping after an error.
Opt-in diagnostics now report a freeze the moment it passes 5 seconds, so a frozen app that gets force-quit still tells us what stopped.
Hovering buttons in pop-ups (call tile, notification banners, formatting popups) no longer logs an error on every mouse move, and room emoji-pack settings stop listening for changes once closed.
The sticker import progress card no longer gets cut off at the right edge of a maximized window.
Fixed screen shares that sometimes kept spinning while their sound played (most often when the sharer started a new share); the tile now picks up the video when it arrives.
Inviting someone to an encrypted room now also lets them read its earlier messages, when the room's history is visible to new members.
The on-screen call overlay (names drawn over your other windows during a call) is now off by default; turn it on in Settings › Calls.
A closed sidebar folder now shows the unread mark when anything inside it has unread messages.
Vommet starts faster: rooms load their saved details in batches instead of one by one.

Screen shares in calls now work like Discord: press Watch stream to see one (with a small preview first), click the stream to show its controls (mute its sound, stop watching), and fullscreen now really fills your screen. Someone streaming from another of their devices now gets one tile instead of two.
Watching streams like Discord: someone sharing their screen keeps their own tile, with LIVE and a Watch button that opens their stream.
Settings has a search box: type a word to find any setting, flip switches right in the results, or jump to the setting's page.
When you join a space you can pick which of its rooms and subspaces to join; Browse rooms in the space menu brings it back later.
Right-click a room or subspace in the room list to leave it; leaving a space can also leave the rooms you pick.
Output and input volume are always available in the headphone and microphone menus, and Settings › Voice now has them under each device, like Discord.
You can now pick which timezone to show on your profile: Share Timezone opens a searchable list of every timezone, with your device's one a tap away.
The log page (Settings › About › Logs) can now copy or save the entries it shows — with your search and level filter applied — as a text file to share.
Import many sticker packs at once by pasting a list of links; they import in the background while you chat. Personal packs are now an advanced option.
Newly imported sticker packs show up in the sticker picker right away, without restarting.

Sidebar folders are no longer made by accident: drop on a space to move it, and hold it over the middle for half a second to make a folder; drag a space out anywhere, a folder with one item left goes away, and right-click (or long-press) a folder to delete it.
Joining or leaving a space now updates the space rail right away, without restarting.
Pictures opened in the gallery no longer flicker through other pictures while a room is still loading.
Someone joining or leaving a call no longer puts the unread dot on the room.
On desktop, the member panel's scrollbar no longer covers the tab row's "more tabs" arrow, and you can drag the tab row sideways with the mouse.
Voice rooms you haven't joined yet show the headphones icon instead of #.
Splash messages can be short lists, with their lines lined up on the left.
Messages no longer show out of order after the sliding sync connection restarts.
When you accept an invite to an encrypted room, you can now read its earlier messages if the person who invited you uses an app that shares them (like Element).
Vommet starts faster and does less work after every sync, especially with Offline sending on in accounts with many rooms.
Catching up after a while away is faster: the app no longer looks up presence for every old message it receives.
Subspaces in the sidebar now list the rooms you haven't joined yet, so you can find and join them instead of seeing an empty heading.
On a space's page, subspaces now list the rooms you haven't joined yet, with a Join button.
Spaces with unread messages get a small white pill on the sidebar's edge, like Discord; it grows on hover and marks the space you're in. Turn it off in Appearance → "Show unread marks on spaces".
Rooms you haven't read now show their dot inside spaces even when set to mentions only, like Discord; muted rooms stay quiet.
The screen-share mark on spaces in the left rail is now a round red icon, matching the headphones mark, instead of a cramped LIVE label.
Discord-style layout: everyone in the room's call is listed first under "In call", even people whose server shares no presence.
On a phone, a call in a text room no longer shows a big empty grey box above the chat; the slim call bar stays until there's video, screen share or someone talking to show.
Profile pictures in the call preview (before you press Join) are sharp now too, not just inside the call.
A long Mutual Spaces or Mutual Rooms list on a profile now scrolls, so the Message button stays on screen.
The nickname panel now says where your nickname is used ("used in this room only", "used across this space") and, with several accounts signed in, which account you're editing.
Android no longer shows "An error occurred while processing notifications / Bad state: No element" for a push from a room the app hasn't stored yet; an invite now shows the usual Room Invite notice.
Developer mode no longer fills the timeline with hidden events; a "Show hidden events" switch under it turns them on, and reactions and deletions are labelled instead of "Unknown message format".
The log page (Settings → About → Logs, developer mode) now has a search box and info/debug/warning/error filters, so you can find specific events quickly.
On Linux, call tiles no longer flicker with garbage (other pictures from the app) while a video or screen share is still loading; they show a spinner until the picture arrives.
Rooms and spaces you were banned from while the app was closed (or before signing in) now show as banned too, instead of as rooms to join.
With Block users on, the Call button is greyed in a DM with someone you've blocked.
New features in Settings › Experiments are now on by default, so you get them without looking; you can still switch any of them off.
New Settings › Data and storage: see what the media cache uses by type (with a chart), clear chosen types, and set a cache size limit and how long unopened media is kept.
On phones, Settings › Data and storage › Automatic media download lets you choose which media downloads by itself on mobile data and on Wi-Fi; media held back shows a blurred preview you tap to load.
Someone's profile now shows the spaces and rooms you share with them; tap one to open it.
With Block users on, a DM with someone you've blocked shows "You blocked <name>" with an Unblock button instead of the message box, and a block badge on its avatar in the room list.
A space you get banned from now stays in your list too, faded, with the reason if one was given; the rooms in it you're still in keep working.
Profile pictures in calls are sharp now instead of blurry.
Videos and audio no longer show "/ -1 B" while downloading; you see the real size, or just how much has downloaded when the size isn't known.
Images and files sent without a caption field no longer show "Unknown message format", Vommet no longer sends attachments with a blank name, and forwarding such an image sends it as a normal image.
The Thread previews setting now shows a live preview card, so you can see each choice before picking it.
Saving new messages to the device is faster, especially in busy rooms and on phones.

Login errors now show next to the field: a wrong username or password says so under the password box, and a server address that doesn't answer says "Couldn't find a Matrix server at …" under the homeserver box.
When a newer Vommet release is out, a small bar at the bottom of the app says so and links to the download page; close it with the X.
The splash screen now shows a random message under the logo while Vommet loads, and Linux shows a splash instead of a blank window.
Select several messages at once (Select in a message's menu, then tap, drag or Shift+click) to delete, copy or forward them together.
Threads now show a card under the message that started them, with the reply count, who replied and a preview of the reply; choose which reply it previews in Settings › Appearance › Threads.
A room you get banned from now stays in your list, greyed, so you can still read it and see the moderator's reason; dismiss it when you're done.
People you've blocked stay blocked after restarting the app.
Going back to a space reopens the room you were in on phones too, and Vommet now remembers it after a restart.
Screen sharing now uses H.264 by default instead of AV1, so it's hardware-encoded on nearly every computer and phone instead of eating CPU. A codec you picked yourself is kept.
Tapping Call twice while a call is still connecting no longer joins it twice, which left mute buttons that didn't match what the call heard.
Long calls no longer drop you for Element Call and Element X users after four hours: Vommet now renews its call membership every hour, as those clients do.
Link previews from Tuwunel-hosted accounts (YouTube links, for one) show the card instead of a loading shimmer that never ends.

You can now change any sound in Vommet, or pick your own audio file, in Settings › Sounds, including new optional sounds for someone joining or leaving a call, deafen, mentions, a dropped call connection and screen sharing.
The room's Widgets panel now shows widgets as tiles, with an "Add widget" tile that lists ready-made widgets (including the new Park Chess) and accepts any widget link.
The image viewer's "3 / 70 · sender" label is now small and readable instead of huge yellow-underlined text.
Typing your full Matrix ID (like @you:example.org) as the username now fills in the homeserver for you, and the login fields no longer offer keyboard suggestions.
Creating an encrypted room no longer fails with "Encryption is already enabled!" on servers that encrypt new rooms by default.
A message you jump to (from a reply, pins, search or the media tab) is highlighted for 3 seconds instead of until you leave the room.
Messages that mention you, reply to you, or ping @room now stand out with a gold tint and a bar on the left.
While Vommet is open, new messages now show as a banner at the top of the app instead of a system notification (on by default on Android; tap to open, swipe up to dismiss).
Settings › Security can now export your message keys to a passphrase-locked file and import key files from Vommet, Element, Cinny and other Matrix apps.
Rooms that name their power levels (for example in Cinny) now show those names as the member list's sections, like "Bot" or "Helper".
New messages no longer wait several seconds when one of your contacts' servers is unreachable.
New experiment "Nickname per space and room": set the name others see in a whole space, or in a single room, from its settings.
Animated GIFs and WebPs uploaded to photo albums now keep moving, and transparent pictures keep their transparency.
Settings › Manage Accounts now shows your homeserver's support page and admin contacts when the server publishes them.
On desktop, clicking a space in the sidebar takes you back to the room you were last in there.
Long space and subspace names in the sidebar now end in "…" instead of running underneath the expand/collapse arrow.
Clicking a link to a space you're already in opens that space instead of a Join Room dialog that spun forever, and link previews load right away.
Hover a reaction to see who reacted, and right-click it to see the full list.
Inserting an emoji into an empty message box now switches the button to Send right away, so the next tap no longer opens the poll menu.
Long room names in the sidebar stay on one line again and end in "…"; hover a name to see it in full.
The green ring around someone who's talking now sits on the edge of their picture, like Discord's, instead of floating around it.
The desktop room list no longer jumps when someone joins or leaves a voice call that's scrolled out of view; you see the change when you scroll up.
Pictures in a mosaic no longer disappear when new messages arrive below them.
Mentions at the start of a line now line up with the text, and their highlight is easier to see.
Leaving a call no longer makes you join the next one muted.
The Home side panel always shows the Direct Messages header and its + button, with a hint to start your first DM when you have none.
Experiment (Clearer subspaces): people in a voice call are listed closer under the room, with full-size pictures, and your own name no longer says "(you)".
Experiment (Clearer subspaces): in a call, your own name in the room list lights up as soon as your microphone picks you up, even in a whisper, after noise suppression.
A room's notification setting now shows what really happens: if your account's defaults keep group chats quiet, it says so, and choosing All Messages makes the room notify again.
Settings › Notifications has "Default notifications" switches for group chats and direct messages that apply on all your devices, and warns if notifications are switched off entirely.
Day dividers in the timeline say Today, Yesterday or the weekday together with the time (switch in Settings › General).
A picture opened from the member panel's Media tab no longer flickers while more pictures load behind it.
Discord-style layout: the desktop room header's icons are all one size, and the panel toggle comes last.
Experiment: Call cards. In several calls at once, each shows its room, space and account, with its own mute and deafen.
Voice rooms in the room list: no ring around their picture, names turn bold while a call is on, and greens are easier to read on light themes.
Experiment (Clearer subspaces): spaces on the left show headphones while a call is on in them, or a red LIVE while someone shares their screen in your call there.
Secure messaging setup now actually appears right after you sign in, and you can replace your recovery key (or lock out a leaked one) in Settings › Security.
With several accounts signed in, notifications say which account they're for.
Room settings › Developer › Room State no longer freezes the app in very large rooms.
After a restart, a room whose last message was edited shows the edited text in the room list.
Sticker rooms stay out of Home › Rooms after a restart.
Someone whose membership is refreshed no longer shows as joining twice; it says they updated their profile.
The topic field when creating a room is one line tall until you type more.
Subspace cards on a space's page are shaded by depth (also in AMOLED) with a faint guide line, and take less room.

Discord-style layout: an "Invite members" card leads the Members tab, the room's full name heads the ▾ room menu, a red count of unread direct messages sits on the Home icon, the space page lists rooms like the left pane, and the space icon has no ring.
Fixed an error after logging out, when the app kept looking up people's online status for the closed account.
Clearer subspaces and voice rooms experiment: voice rooms show who's in them with a ring and headphones, and in a call you're in, people light up while they talk and show a mark when they're muted.
Diagnostics (only if you opted in) now break down where the app spends time drawing frames and syncing, so we can find what makes it slow.
Android: notifications for encrypted messages no longer go missing while the app is running in the background; if a message can't be decrypted in time, you get a "New message" notification instead.
Direct messages: the "identity changed" warning appears straight away when a contact resets their security keys.
The mute button in calls turns red when you're muted, and shows your real microphone state even while you share your screen's sound.
The notification test explains why a message wouldn't notify you, and which rule decided it.
"Mark space as read" in a space's menu, including its subspaces.
Pictures that failed to load try again by themselves instead of staying blank.
Small pictures in the media mosaic are no longer blown up past their own size.
Polls that can't be shown say "Couldn't display this poll" instead of a grey error box.
Discord-style layout: the member panel's tab row shows arrows when tabs don't fit, and arrow keys move between tabs; with the picture gallery experiment, arrow keys work from the Media tab too.
The diagnostics name tag is saved when you finish typing, in capitals.
Formatting made easy: on desktop, select text for a formatting bar, or use shortcuts like Ctrl+B, Ctrl+I and Ctrl+U; on phones, use Format in the selection menu or the Aa button next to emoji.
Paste a link over selected text to turn it into a link, and __double underscores__ underline text.

Discord-style layout (experiment): the room's top row shows just Invite, Call and Search; everything else is in the ▾ room menu. The member panel's tabs scroll (also with the mouse wheel) when they don't fit.
Text between slashes, like /this/, is sent in italics and shown that way as you type. You can switch it off in Settings › Appearance.

The call button shows the call's state: start, join (with how many are in it), in the call, or locked (with a short explanation when you can't join). Direct messages get a single call button; the classic call moves to right-click or long-press.
Threads list: see every thread in a room, newest activity first, with an All threads / My threads filter. Opening a thread marks it read.
Block users, as an experiment (Settings › Experiments › Chat and messages): block or unblock someone from their profile, and see everyone you've blocked under Settings › Security.

After you sign in, an account that hasn't set up secure messaging (or a device that isn't verified yet) gets a guided setup screen, so your encrypted messages stay readable on all your devices. Accounts that are already set up see nothing new.
Each room's name has a small marker that says whether it's encrypted; tap it for a short explanation.
Direct messages warn you when the other person's security key changes (someone could be impersonating them), or when they never set up secure messaging.
Notifications are no longer silenced just because another device of yours is online; they're quieted only while you're actively chatting in that room elsewhere.
With several accounts, push notifications now arrive for all of them, not just one.
Settings › Notifications lists your account's push registrations, with a Remove button; Vommet cleans up its own stale ones.
Your avatar and other people's are sharp in the profile card and on opened profiles.
Voice room badges on avatars are crisp instead of blurry.
On phones during a call, opening the keyboard shrinks the call to a slim strip so you can still see the chat.
On phones, tapping outside the message box clears a text selection.
Tapping the icon of the space you're already in opens the space's home page.
Subspaces on a space's page are easier to tell apart: nested cards get their own shade and a coloured bar.
Linux: very tall or wide pictures (like long screenshots) are no longer squashed; the viewer opens them at full resolution.
The 'Send original' switch is now 'Remove hidden info' (on by default), with a 'What's this?' explanation of what a picture carries, like location or camera.
Right-click (or long-press) a picture or file in the member panel's Media and Files tabs to jump to it, forward it, save it or copy it.
Settings › Experiments has a 'Back to new-user defaults' button, with 'Restore my setup' to undo it.
Experiments: open a voice room's text chat in one click; manage a space's rooms from its menu (reorder, move, remove); and a picture gallery in the viewer (arrow keys or swipe).
Reordering rooms in a space no longer brings back rooms you removed.
Diagnostics (only if you opted in) can carry an optional name tag you type yourself, and now count what happened to notifications.
Messages that use <font color> (sent by some bots) show their text again instead of vanishing.
A direct message you just accepted moves to the top of your DM list straight away.
Long space and room names wrap in their appearance settings instead of pushing the edit button off a phone screen.
Clearer subspaces and voice rooms, as an experiment (Settings › Experiments › Layout and sidebar): subspaces get headers with a guide line, and voice rooms show how many people are in the call.
Discord-style layout experiment, on phones: the room's name glides into the pinned row as the banner collapses, instead of showing twice.
Android notifications: Vommet re-checks its UnifiedPush app and registration at every start, so setups from older versions start working again.
Push notifications now get set up even if another app (like Element's email notifications) left an incomplete entry on your account.
Unread-count-only pushes (sent by servers like matrix.org) no longer show up as "Unknown Notification Data".
Android: Vommet appears in the share sheet. Share pictures, files or text from other apps into any chat.

Forwarding (experiment) works like Telegram now: pick a chat, and the message waits above the composer, where you can hide the sender or the caption, or change the recipient. Forwarded messages show who they came from.
Sliding sync experiment: unread counts, unread dots and notifications now work on Synapse servers like matrix.org.
Profiles (names, pictures, banners, status) load faster, and Vommet asks the server for them far less often.
Faster startup: Vommet no longer sometimes waits up to 30 seconds for the first sync.
The member list no longer shows someone you're talking with under "Offline" with a green dot.
On servers that don't share presence, people show as "Unknown" (with a hollow dot) instead of all looking offline.
Voice rooms show a small speaker badge on their avatar, so you can tell them apart even when they have their own picture.

Discord-style layout experiment: the member panel gets Members, Media, Files and Pins tabs, member rows show who's in voice or sharing their screen, and on phones the room's name and actions share one row.
The sliding sync experiment now says that unread counts don't work yet on Synapse servers (like matrix.org).
Press and hold a sticker to preview it; slide to another sticker, and let go to close. A tap still sends.
Stickers that failed to load no longer stay blank until you restart; Vommet tries again.
Turning the profile and audio quick controls on or off during a call applies your output volume right away.

The Experiments page is tidier: experiments are grouped by topic, there is one warning at the top, experiments that need a restart say so, and Vommet offers to restart when you leave the page after changing one.
After joining a room on another server, missing older messages are loaded automatically; "Reload History" in the room menu fetches them again.
Android: when editing a message, you can drag the selection handles back again after selecting backwards.
Messages show as soon as they can be decrypted, without reopening the room.
Restoring your key backup now downloads the keys, so older encrypted messages become readable.
Copy image: right-click (or long-press) a picture to put it on your clipboard and paste it anywhere.
Forward a message to other rooms, as an experiment (Settings › Experiments › Chat experiments).
Unsent messages are kept per room and thread while Vommet is open, as an experiment.
Send while offline, as an experiment: messages you send without a connection go out by themselves when you're back online, even after closing the app.
Pin any room to the sidebar, as an experiment (Settings › Experiments).
Unread direct messages first, newest at the top, as an experiment (Settings › Experiments).

Discord-style layout, as an experiment (Settings › Experiments): spaces and rooms get Discord-style headers and menus, the member list is grouped by who's online, and panes can be resized and banners collapsed.
A Banner glow setting for how space and room banners blend into the page.
Your space order in the sidebar is kept after a restart (it wasn't saved when you dragged a space to a new place).
Fewer errors when you leave a room while it is still loading.
Notifications: Vommet now lists the UnifiedPush apps on your phone, shows which one it uses (you can change it) and tells you if none is installed.
Right-click (or long-press) an enlarged picture to save it; tap a person's banner or avatar in their profile, or a space's avatar in its summary, to see it full size. "Download" is now "Save as…".
Your profile card (click your name) shows your banner and your current status.
Clearing your bio from the profile menu works (the confirmation no longer closes by itself).
Drag spaces and folders in the sidebar to reorder them on desktop, as an experiment (Settings › Experiments).
The version under Settings › About is now the tester release's name, like testing-2026-10-08.
Start a call in any chat from the room menu (Call), as part of the calls-in-chats experiment; incoming calls there ring like other calls. The older one-to-one call is still there as "Classic call".
Calls across homeservers, as an experiment: hear people whose call runs on another server's media server.
Explore says "no public spaces" (or rooms) when that's what's missing, instead of always "no public rooms".
Android: should no longer crash when someone starts or switches a screen share (please tell us if it still does).
Android: screen sharing should now start properly. It shares your whole screen (sharing a single app isn't possible on Android).
Fixed: Vommet no longer crashes as soon as it opens (this broke the first three builds of 10-07).
Sign in with your server's own login page in the browser, on servers that offer it (like nether.im).
Noise suppression for your microphone in calls, as an experiment: Settings › Experiments.
Screen sharing on Linux lets you choose which sound to include: none, all apps, or one app, now including apps like Spotify and mpv. Shared sound is now in stereo.
Only one screen share at a time: starting a new one replaces the old one, and Stop ends it completely.
When someone switches what they share, the enlarged view follows the new stream instead of going blank.
Room banners now show as a header above the chat, like space banners, and open full size when you click them.
Discord-style call controls: a "Voice Connected" card, and mute and deafen buttons with device menus next to your name.
Profile and audio quick controls, as an experiment: a profile card with status and presence, microphone and output volume sliders, and a Voice Settings shortcut.
matrix: links from other apps open the room or profile in Vommet (and matrix.to links on Android).
Commet supporter badges are shown as-is, without a donation check at startup.
Joining a call retries once by itself if the network drops for a moment.
Message timestamps, as an experiment (Settings › Experiments): type <t:UNIX> or $[UNIX] and everyone sees the time in their own time zone.
Calls in ordinary chats, as an experiment (Settings › Experiments): when people start an Element Call in a group chat or DM, Vommet shows who's in it and a Join button.
Fixed: right after signing in, rooms no longer show up twice in the room list.
This "What's New" page: after an update, Vommet lists what changed since the version you last used.
Direct messages you accept in Vommet now show up under Direct Messages instead of as a group.
Right-click (or long-press) a chat to mark it as a direct message, or to undo that.
Change your display name from the menu on your own profile. Every menu option now explains what it does.
Screen sharing can include sound.
Optional diagnostics: you can choose to send timings and error types (never your messages) to help us find bugs. Change it any time in Settings › Privacy.
A welcome screen after your first sign-in, with a button to join the Vommet room.
Big accounts start faster: the room list shows up sooner and stays responsive while the rest loads.
Importing a sticker pack no longer adds it to your favourites, and every pack in your sticker rooms shows up in the picker.
Stickers in the picker are sharp on phones.
Space banners show the whole picture while loading and stay sharp after a restart.
When the last message in a room was deleted, the room list now says "Message deleted".
In calls, people who join after you no longer appear as an endless loading tile.
